summary: [standards] atip.helpjson.07 and its test still say the outside-a-repository answer is never CONFIG_MISSING. Since codes-rename the error is CONFIG_REQUIRED (CONFIG_MISSING is only the status warning), so assert_ne!(code, CONFIG_MISSING) in atip_helpjson.rs:196 can no longer fail and the scenario text names a code the error no longer has; the codes-rename guard exempts CONFIG_MISSING whole, so it did not flag them. The same-answer-in-and-out assertion on the next line still fails if the refusal reads the repo, so the behavior is proved; the name is the stale part. Blast radius: the scenario text (digest) and one assertion; no behavior.
